title: Batch Bayesian Active Learning with Partial Batch Label Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2510.09877v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Over the past couple of decades, many active learning acquisition functions have been proposed, leaving practitioners with an unclear choice of which to use. Bayesian active learning offers principled objectives with explainable intuition, including Expected Error Reduction (EER), Expected Predictive Information Gain (EPIG), and Bayesian Active Learning by Disagreements (BALD). A key challenge of such methods is the difficulty of extending to the batch setting, leading to either computational challenges (BatchBALD) or dramatic performance drops (top-$B$ selection). In this work, we extend active learning's Bayesian Decision Theory framework to derive Partial Batch Label Sampling (ParBaLS) for the EPIG algorithm. We show experimentally that ParBaLS EPIG gives superior performance for a variety of datasets with different budgets using Bayesian logistic regression on embeddings from large pre-trained models. Our code is available

translated_title: 基于部分批次标签采样的批次贝叶斯主动学习
translated_abstract: 在过去几十年中，许多主动学习采集函数被相继提出，使得实践者难以明确选择应使用哪一种。贝叶斯主动学习提供了具有可解释直觉的原则性目标，包括期望误差减少（EER）、期望预测信息增益（EPIG）以及基于分歧的贝叶斯主动学习（BALD）。这类方法的一个关键挑战是难以扩展到批次设置，这会导致要么面临计算上的挑战（如BatchBALD），要么出现显著的性能下降（如top-B选择）。在这项工作中，我们扩展了主动学习的贝叶斯决策理论框架，为EPIG算法推导出了部分批次标签采样方法。我们通过实验表明，在来自大型预训练模型的嵌入表示上使用贝叶斯逻辑回归时，ParBaLS EPIG在不同预算下的多种数据集上都能取得卓越的性能。我们的代码已公开。
tldr: 该论文扩展了主动学习的贝叶斯决策理论框架，提出部分批次标签采样方法ParBaLS，使EPIG算法在批次设置下既避免了BatchBALD的计算难题，又克服了top-B选择的性能下降，在不同数据集和预算下均取得卓越性能。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the Bayesian Decision Theory framework for active learning to propose Partial Batch Label Sampling (ParBaLS) for the EPIG algorithm, achieving superior batch-mode performance while avoiding BatchBALD's computational challenges and top-B selection's performance drops.
